clause: StudioLiveFilter live-filter-layer mechanism + smart-filter attachment + per-filter masking [STU-RAS-037]

scope.summary: Implement ONLY the 14.4-owned live-filter mechanism (the concrete filter catalog is 14.9): the non-destructive live_filter-kind layer hosting one StudioLiveFilter applied to layers below or clipped to its parent; smart-filter attachment to a placed_asset container; per-filter masking; and the rule that any 14.9 filter runnable non-destructively MUST be available as a StudioLiveFilter, with a destructive apply-to-pixels form (via MT-024) also existing for each. Do not enumerate the 14.9 catalog here.
acceptance_criteria: live_filter layer + smart-filter attachment + per-filter masking work
re-editable non-destructive + destructive apply-to-pixels form; consumes 14.9 catalog
proof_targets: live-filter re-edit + smart-filter re-render runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: attach a live_filter layer, edit its parameters non-destructively, mask part of it, then apply-to-pixels and confirm a distinct history entry
live: attach a smart filter to a placed_asset and confirm it re-renders on source change
test: a 14.9 non-destructive filter is exposed as a StudioLiveFilter

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Live filters & smart filters

risk_if_missed: No non-destructive filter mechanism; smart filters and per-filter masking absent; 14.9 filters can't be live.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
